clue.text: Putin sat around getting clothes

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of the words Putin sat are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: The Russian president lounges about while getting dressed.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranging PUTINSAT gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A trouser suit for women is a set of clothes, so the outfit stands for the garments worn.

clue.text: Small green thing with taps giving product of Georgia

parts.note: a pea is a small green vegetable
taps come as hot and cold, abbreviated H and C, here in the order C, H

explanation.surface: A tiny green object comes with plumbing fittings, yielding some Georgian export.
explanation.walkthrough: Georgia, the US state, is nicknamed the Peach State; the clue tempts you towards the country in the Caucasus.
explanation.definitionFit: Georgia is famous for its fruit crop, nicknamed the Peach State, so the fruit is its product.

clue.text: "5 cents," I said, "for Rimsky-Korsakov?"

indicators.note: said tells us the words before it are spoken, and we write what they sound like

parts.note: in the US a five-cent coin is a nickel; I gives I

explanation.surface: Someone offers five cents for the Russian composer, as if bidding on him.
explanation.walkthrough: NICKEL plus I spoken together gives the composer's first name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian composer Rimsky-Korsakov had the forename Nikolai, so the surname identifies the given name.

clue.text: Certain to include note about plane

indicators.note: to include means the word for certain takes the following letters inside it

parts.note: certain means sure
fa is a note of the sol-fa scale
C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Something certain contains a note concerning an aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plane' looks like an aeroplane, but it is the geometric sense: a flat expanse.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry a plane is a flat two-dimensional expanse, which is a synonym for a flat face or top layer.

clue.text: Intimate spotted losing head

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter of the word for spotted is dropped

parts.note: spotted skin is pimply

explanation.surface: A close friend with acne loses their top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intimate' is the verb (to hint), not the adjective meaning close.
explanation.definitionFit: To intimate something is to suggest it indirectly, a synonym of hinting or suggesting.

clue.text: Understood this classical style of architecture

parts.note: if you got it, you understood it
hic is Latin, a classical language, for this

explanation.surface: A reader grasps that this is a style of classical architecture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Classical' looks like part of the architectural description, but it signals Latin for 'this'.
explanation.definitionFit: The pointed-arch medieval building style is named after the Goths and is a style of architecture.

clue.text: Former unit gets money to stop Bond

parts.note: one is a single unit

indicators.note: to stop means the letter for money plugs the middle of the word for bond

parts.note: a tie is a bond

explanation.surface: A former military unit gets funding to halt a spy called Bond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' wants to be 007, but it is a tie.
explanation.definitionFit: Onetime is an adjective meaning previous, a synonym of former as in a onetime champion.

clue.text: Shakespearean short speech is under an hour

indicators.note: in a down clue being under means coming below, so the speech follows the letter for hour

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hour

indicators.note: short means the last letter of the word for speech is cut off

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: A brief Shakespearean speech lasts less than an hour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shakespearean' looks descriptive of the speech, but it defines a character.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamlet's loyal friend is a character from Shakespeare's play, so a Shakespearean figure.

clue.text: Scandal-free family welcomes European

indicators.note: welcomes means the word for family takes the letter for European inside it

parts.note: a clan is a family group

explanation.surface: A respectable family with no scandal welcomes a European visitor.
explanation.definitionFit: A clean record or reputation is one without scandal, an idiomatic sense of untarnished.

clue.text: Being immunised against snacks, essentially, confused niece

parts.note: V is short for versus, against

indicators.note: essentially picks out the essence, the central letters of snacks
confused means the letters of niece are jumbled

explanation.surface: A puzzled niece is against snacks while being vaccinated.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle of SNACKS is AC; NIECE rearranged gives CINEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A vaccinee is a being, a person, who is receiving a vaccine, so the noun phrase fits.

clue.text: One who has a question like knight I don't really know

parts.note: as means like
K is the chess notation for knight
er is the hesitant noise made by someone unsure

explanation.surface: A puzzled person, perhaps a knight, admits they don't really know.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who poses a query is an enquirer, the literal agent noun of the verb to query.

clue.text: Vegetation Venus possibly freezes evenly

parts.note: Venus is an example of a planet

indicators.note: evenly picks the even-numbered letters, the second, fourth and sixth, of freezes

explanation.surface: Plant life on Venus might freeze in a uniform way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vegetation' suggests plants on another world, but it is the definition of a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A plane tree is a broad-leaved tree, an example of vegetation.

clue.text: Small mountain lion can try frantically to be a candidate

parts.note: a hill is a small mountain

indicators.note: frantically means the letters of lion can try are thrown about wildly

explanation.surface: A lion on a small mountain frantically tries to stand for election.
explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle's theme is the 2016 US presidential election.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the Democratic candidate for US president in 2016, so a candidate.

clue.text: See 12
Cattle mob a candidate

indicators.note: to mob is to crowd round, so the word for cattle surrounds a

parts.note: kine is an old plural meaning cows or cattle

explanation.surface: A herd of cattle crowds round someone running for office.
explanation.definitionFit: Tim Kaine was the Democratic vice-presidential candidate in 2016, Clinton's running mate.

clue.text: North Korean sound equipment goes belly-up without echo

indicators.note: without means a letter is removed
in a down clue going belly-up turns the word upside down, so it is read from the bottom

parts.note: a mike is a microphone, sound equipment
Echo is E in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: North Korean audio gear fails, losing its echo.
explanation.walkthrough: MIKE turned over gives EKIM; dropping E leaves the leader's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Kim is the family name of North Korea's ruling dynasty, so a North Korean figure.

clue.text: It's one man going round St Paul's area

indicators.note: going round suggests the letters of the words are spun into a new order

explanation.surface: A single man walks around a church or neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'St Paul's' wants to be the London cathedral; it is the state capital of Minnesota, so its area is the state.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Paul is the capital city of this US state, so the state is the area around it.

clue.text: Quiet performance keeps queen out of terrible danger in psyop

indicators.note: keeps means the word for a silent show holds the other letters inside

parts.note: a mime is a performance without words

indicators.note: terrible means the remaining letters are mangled
out of means the letters for queen leave the word danger

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the queen

explanation.surface: A silent act keeps the queen safe from awful peril during a psychological operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen' is ER, the royal cipher of Elizabeth Regina; 'out of' takes it from danger before 'terrible' shuffles what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A psyop is a psychological operation, a manipulative ploy of the kind also called a head game.

clue.text: Old man crosses line climbing mountain

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means the letters read upwards, backwards
crosses means the word for father straddles the letter for line

parts.note: an old man is slang for a father, pa

explanation.surface: An elderly man crosses a line while scaling a peak.
explanation.walkthrough: PA around L gives PLA, which read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An alp is a high mountain, particularly one in Switzerland's range.

clue.text: Millions do not start to appreciate change candidate

indicators.note: do not start to means the word for appreciate loses its first letter

parts.note: to like is to appreciate
pence are coins, loose change

explanation.surface: Millions of voters don't begin to value a candidate promising change.
explanation.definitionFit: Mike Pence was the Republican vice-presidential candidate in 2016, Trump's running mate.

clue.text: Family name turned up in motion

parts.note: kin are family

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: to cite is to name, as a source

explanation.surface: A family's name surfaces as things get moving.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinetic describes energy of movement, an adjective meaning moving or active.

clue.text: Royalty is nosey about North Carolina

indicators.note: about means the word for nosey wraps around the state's letters

parts.note: someone who pries is nosey
NC is the postal abbreviation for North Carolina

explanation.surface: A busybody snoops on the royal family in North Carolina.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal sons are princes, so the plural noun stands for members of royalty.

clue.text: Candidate finally hit bottom

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word hit

parts.note: the rump is the buttocks, the bottom

explanation.surface: A political hopeful eventually reaches rock bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Donald Trump was the Republican presidential candidate in 2016, and won.

clue.text: Upturned barrel containing very little water a component of washing machine

indicators.note: containing means the reversed barrel holds the other letters inside
in a down clue upturned means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a butt is a large barrel

indicators.note: very little of the word water means only its first letter is taken

parts.note: a component is something in a whole, so these words give the word in

explanation.surface: An upside-down barrel holding a drop of water forms part of a laundry appliance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upturned' turns BUTT into TTUB. 'A component of' looks like part of the definition, but it supplies IN, as a component is in something.
explanation.definitionFit: A twin tub is a laundry appliance with separate drums for washing and spin-drying.

clue.text: Actor is not bothered bathed in special lighting effect

indicators.note: bathed in means the shuffled letters sit inside the letters for the lighting

parts.note: UV, ultraviolet, is a special lighting effect

indicators.note: bothered means the letters of is not are jumbled

explanation.surface: A performer stays unruffled under theatrical lights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is not bothered' reads as calm, but 'bothered' signals the anagram; UV is ultraviolet light used for stage effects.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter Ustinov was a celebrated actor, playwright and raconteur, an example of a performer.

clue.text: What the candidates are doing on the trot

definitions.meaning: candidates contest the election, standing for office
on the trot means one after another, consecutively

explanation.surface: Election hopefuls are busy and always on the move.
explanation.definitionFit: Candidates are said to be in the race, and consecutive also means this, as in three days this way.

clue.text: Luxury car carries one track competitor

indicators.note: carries means the letters for the car hold the word for one inside

parts.note: RR is short for Rolls-Royce, a luxury car
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.surface: A posh car transports a solitary runner.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone competing on a racetrack, whether athlete, horse or car, is a contestant in the race.

clue.text: Laugh about George Bush on campaign battlefront

indicators.note: about means the word for laugh goes around the president's letter

parts.note: a titter is a little laugh
George W Bush was nicknamed Dubya, for his middle initial W

explanation.surface: People chuckle over George Bush on the campaign front line.
explanation.definitionFit: The social media platform was where much of the 2016 campaign was fought, a witty description of the site.

clue.text: Retailer group backing senior officer

indicators.note: backing means the word for group is reversed

parts.note: a set is a group
CO is a commanding officer

explanation.surface: A shop chain is supported by a group behind a top officer.
explanation.walkthrough: TESCO is a large British supermarket chain.
explanation.definitionFit: Tesco is a major British supermarket chain, an example of a shop business.

clue.text: Queen possibly to regret having bottom grabbed by both hands

indicators.text: having bottom grabbed by both hands
indicators.note: the bottom letter of the word for regret is held between the letters for left and right hands

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: A queen might be sorry to have her backside grabbed.
explanation.walkthrough: Both hands are L and R; the bottom letter E of RUE sits between them, giving RU + LER.
explanation.definitionFit: A queen is an example of a monarch or sovereign, so 'possibly' marks it as one instance.

clue.text: Underground places for Mexican food in the morning featured by broadcaster

indicators.note: featured by means the broadcaster's letters hold the rest

parts.note: CBS is an American broadcaster

indicators.note: in means the food goes inside the morning letters

parts.note: AM means in the morning
a taco is a Mexican dish

explanation.surface: A TV network features Mexican food on a morning show.
explanation.definitionFit: Catacombs are subterranean burial chambers, underground places such as those in Rome.

clue.text: Volunteers working inside left, having a key

indicators.note: inside means the word for working goes within the volunteers' letters

parts.note: the TA, the Territorial Army, was the UK's volunteer reserve force
on means working, as a machine

explanation.surface: Volunteers working inside have left, but one has a key.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonal music is written in a definite musical key, as opposed to atonal music.

clue.text: Despicable person going round clubs is bigoted

indicators.note: going round means the word for despicable person surrounds the rest

parts.note: a rat is a despicable person
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A nasty character who frequents nightclubs shows prejudice.
explanation.definitionFit: A person showing racial prejudice is bigoted, so the adjective fits as a type of bigotry.

clue.text: Michelle and Barack Obama initially impressed by policy for hairstyle

indicators.note: impressed by means the initials are pressed into the word for policy

parts.note: insurance cover is a policy

indicators.note: initially picks the first letters of the three names

explanation.surface: The Obamas are won over by a policy on haircuts.
explanation.walkthrough: A nod to Trump's famous hairstyle, in a puzzle themed on the 2016 election.
explanation.definitionFit: A comb-over is a hairstyle arranging long strands across a bald patch.
